title: Charcoal Briquettes 8kg

drivers.name: Thanksgiving holiday
drivers.evidence: Historical median x0.61 vs baseline; noise-adjusted x0.87. 2 past occurrences. Event weakens demand.

drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: Store closed Mon, removing ~1/7 of weekly sales. No prior closure data, but linear drop expected.

adjustment.analysis: Thanksgiving reduces demand (median x0.61, noise-adjusted x0.87), but the store is closed Monday, eliminating one day of sales. The price is unchanged, so no lift. Past promotions show high volatility, but no promotion is scheduled. The classical model's x0.87 is close but overweights the event effect; the closed day likely reduces sales by ~14%, but the event effect is already partly captured. Adjust down to 0.78. Noise-adjusted evidence is moderate, so shrink toward 1.0. No promotion, so no uplift. Downside spread increases slightly due to uncertainty in event impact.
